Former editor's name deletion from voter rolls impacts passport

A former editor's name was reportedly deleted from voter rolls due to the 'Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Registration' (SVEEP) process. This deletion has subsequently affected his passport application, with police reportedly unable to clear it. Opposition parties have cited this incident to criticize the central government.
